## Open

### F-348 — Steps built by one factory must carry distinct names per table

> _2026-10-04 · core/blong-cucumber · open_

Four fixture steps produced by a single step factory all reported the same function name, and the
run failed a scenario whose steps share a subtest name (Duplicate step name detected), because the
runner appends a per-step suffix to the reported name instead of replacing it. Naming each chain
step after the table it asserts - a small Object.defineProperty on the function name inside the
factory - is the fix. Worth knowing before writing a second step factory, because the failure looks
like a chain bug rather than a naming one.

### F-355 — A backtick inside a feature template literal breaks the suite at load

> _2026-10-04 · core/blong-cucumber · open_

Feature files are TypeScript template literals, so a backtick in the Gherkin prose ends the string
and the whole suite fails to load with Expected semicolon got ident. It happened twice in the same
task (a note reading the deny all viewer, and earlier an em dash quoted in a Background comment),
each costing a test run to notice. Write feature prose in plain text; backticks are for the doc
comment above the string, which is ordinary TypeScript. A guard would be cheap: lint a feature
template for an unescaped backtick on the exported string's lines.
